reason: The unfired blanks need heat to become strong flooring, and the solar heating bay is available.
expectation: The blanks will be fired into hard pieces suitable for the growing bay floor.

effect: The fired blanks are now ceramic blocks suitable for non-pressure paving in the growing bay.
reaction: The distinction between paving and pressure containment is useful.
reason: The blocks can form the floor needed beneath the liner.
expectation: The blocks will pave the growing bay floor.

effect: The bay is level, but the hard block edges still need padding before the liner can be installed.
reaction: The remaining protection step makes physical sense.
reason: Insulation felt looks suitable for padding the hard floor beneath the liner.
expectation: The felt will cushion the floor for the pressure liner.

effect: The felt needed a clean fabric cover first; the resulting padded underlay can now protect the liner from the ceramic floor.
reaction: The compatibility feedback made the missing preparation clear.
reason: The padded underlay belongs on the level ceramic floor before the pressure liner is installed.
expectation: The underlay will cover the hard floor and make it safe for the liner.

effect: The floor is protected, and the next goal is to create an inhabited, illuminated room.
reaction: The layered floor has a clear protective purpose.
reason: The folded pressure envelope needs to go on the protected floor to form the room.
expectation: The envelope will be installed on the padded floor, ready for air and lighting.

effect: The pressure envelope is installed and sealed; the room still needs breathable air and lighting.
reaction: The separation between imported pressure seals and local structural support is clear.
reason: The sealed room needs breathing gas to become inhabitable.
expectation: The gas supply will pressurize the growing room with breathable air.

effect: The growing room is pressurized and passed its leak check; it still needs illumination.
reaction: Walking into the inflated room feels like meaningful progress.
reason: The grow-light rails are the available lighting for the pressurized room.
expectation: The rails will provide lighting in the growing room.

effect: The light rails completed the inhabited growing room; the service spine also supplies circulation and heat, and the chapter's goals are complete.
reaction: The explanation that the array was sized for the lights made the finished room feel more credible.

mostWorthwhile.text: Preparing the floor and installing the pressure envelope was the most worthwhile passage: it showed why the blocks provide support while padding and imported seals protect and contain the air.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the light rails was straightforward and less involving than preparing the floor, though it completed the room.

surprise.text: The felt could not be applied directly to the floor; it first needed a clean fabric cover to make the protective underlay.

arbitrary.text: The fabric-cover requirement was not obvious before trying the felt on the floor, but the resulting explanation gave it a clear protective purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see the growing room put to use; building it combined satisfying progress with useful physical explanations.
